items.text: Same issue in desktop/user.scss:522: .group-member-info .name original 30% became dark-light-choose(50%, 50%) instead of (30%, 70%)
.wmd-input text color uses darken($primary, 40%) which was not updated - darkening an already dark primary color could cause readability issues in some theme configurations

In .topic-meta-data h5 a, the original code had color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) but was changed to dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)). The lightness for the light theme changed from 30% to 70%, which is a dramatic inversion
dark-light-choose appears to swap the light-theme value from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%) to scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) and vice-versa for dark in mobile/modal.scss
desktop/topic-post.scss: .topic-meta-data h5 a light-theme value changed from $primary 30% to 70% lightness, causing visual regression on light themes
Several converted one-line rules gain a stray space before closing brace (')); }' instead of '));}'), e.g. in desktop/topic-list.scss, desktop/queued-posts.scss:14, and desktop/topic-post.scss
mobile/modal.scss: .custom-message-length light-theme value changed from $primary 70% to 30% lightness, inconsistent with desktop equivalent which correctly keeps 70%
In topic-post.css the original code used $lightness: 70% but the replacement uses $lightness: 30% for the light theme. This makes the text significantly darker than intended.

In `.custom-message-length` the light and dark values are swapped - the new code is (light 30%, dark 70%) but should be (70%, 30%), causing mobile and desktop stylesheets to disagree since desktop/modal.scss:94 was converted correctly

The dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, X%), scale-color($secondary, 100-X%)) expression is hand-copied 115 times across 32 files; a one-argument helper would encode the 100-X rule once and prevent the 5 swap mismatches
In desktop/user.scss and mobile/user.scss, .group-member-info .name was changed to 50/50 mapping (same as .title) instead of 30/70, removing the intended visual hierarchy between names and titles
In mobile/topic-post.scss, .topic-map h3 was changed to 50/50 mapping but desktop uses 20/80, causing mobile heading to become much lighter in light theme and inconsistent with desktop
In desktop/topic-post.scss line 291: The dark-light-choose conversion swaps the light and dark lightness values, regressing the existing light-theme color instead of preserving it

In mobile `.group-member-info .name` rule the same defect as desktop/user.scss:522 - the new code is (50%, 50%) but should be (30%, 70%), causing the name to lose contrast against its title on light theme
Light-theme value changed for .group-member-info .name: original 30% became dark-light-choose(50%, 50%) instead of (30%, 70%); name becomes as faint as .title, losing visual hierarchy in light theme

Light-theme value changed for topic-map h3: original 20% became dark-light-choose(50%, 50%) instead of (20%, 80%); mobile heading fails AA contrast (~3.2:1) and diverges from desktop/topic-post.scss:321

Light/dark arguments swapped for .custom-message-length: original 70% became dark-light-choose(30%, 70%) instead of (70%, 30%); hint text turns dark in light theme and near-white in dark theme, diverging from desktop/modal.scss:94

dark-light-choose returns its first argument for light themes, so the change alters light-theme color from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) to scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), which is a big possibly unintended contrast shift

In desktop/topic-post.scss, .topic-meta-data h5 a uses inverted dark-light-choose values (70% for light theme instead of 30%), making the light theme link color much lighter than before and inconsistent with base topic-post link styling

Light/dark arguments swapped for .topic-meta-data h5 a: original $lightness 30% became dark-light-choose(70%, 30%) instead of (30%, 70%); light theme poster-name link contrast drops below WCAG AA (from ~5.9 to ~1.9) and dark theme gets the dim value

In `.topic-meta-data h5 a` the light and dark values are swapped - the new code is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))` but should be (30%, 70%), causing light-theme regression with contrast dropping from 5.92:1 to 1.88:1 which fails WCAG AA

In `h3` (topic-map links section) the light-theme value changed incorrectly - the new code is (50%, 50%) but should be (20%, 80%) to match the original 20% and the correctly converted desktop twin at desktop/topic-post.scss:321, causing contrast to drop from 8.32:1 to 3.19:1 which fails AA for normal text
dark-light-choose changes the light-theme h3 color from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%) to scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%) which may be unintentional

In `.group-member-info .name` the light-theme value changed incorrectly - the new code is (50%, 50%) but should be (30%, 70%), causing the name to fade from #646464 to #909090 and lose hierarchy distinction from the `.title` beneath it (appears to be copy-paste error from .title line)
In mobile/modal.scss line 102: The light/dark scale-color percentages are reversed - should keep 70% for light-theme and 30% for dark-theme to match desktop .custom-message-length styling
In mobile/modal.scss, .custom-message-length uses inverted lightness values (30%/70%) compared to desktop (70%/30%), making hint text darker in light theme and brighter in dark theme than intended
In mobile/user.scss line 497, the lightness value for dark themes should be inverted to 70% instead of being changed to 50%. This change may lead to unintended visual regressions in light themes.

The light theme color for `.topic-meta-data h5 a` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, which may unintentionally reduce contrast and affect readability. This change should be reviewed to ensure it aligns with design intentions.

This change for desktop/user.css changes $primary from 30% to 50% for the light theme; most other changes preserve the original $primary value and move the complement to $secondary for dark. Consider reviewing this (also applies to a similar .name change in the mobile variant).

Conversion incomplete: .topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification still uses bare scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%) without dark-light-choose, so dark themes are lightened from light text colour
desktop/user.scss and mobile/user.scss: .group-member-info .name changed from $primary 30% to 50% lightness, altering light-theme appearance
Comment at common/base/discourse.scss:73 still describes old default 'scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)' which is now stale after conversion

In mobile/topic-post.scss line 49: The light-theme $lightness for .topic-map h3 was changed from 20% to 50%, altering light-theme appearance - should preserve original 20% for light variant and use complementary 80% for dark variant to match desktop stylesheet
mobile/topic-post.scss: h3 light-theme value changed from $primary 20% to 50% lightness, while desktop keeps 20%

dark-light-choose changes .group-member-info .name in light mode from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) to scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), which is inconsistent with the keep light theme, adjust dark theme pattern elsewhere

Inconsistent theme handling: #file-uploading uses scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%) while sibling #draft-status was updated to use dark-light-choose, which may cause visibility issues for #file-uploading text in dark themes

issues.claim: In desktop/topic-post.scss, `.topic-meta-data h5 a` has its dark-light-choose arguments swapped. The original light-theme `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` became `dark-light-choose(70%, 30%)` instead of `(30%, 70%)`, so the light-theme link becomes much lighter and lower-contrast.

In mobile/modal.scss, `.custom-message-length` has its light/dark values swapped. The original 70% became `dark-light-choose(30%, 70%)` instead of `(70%, 30%)`, which disagrees with desktop/modal.scss.

In desktop/user.scss and mobile/user.scss, `.group-member-info .name` was converted to `dark-light-choose(50%, 50%)` instead of `(30%, 70%)`. This changes the light-theme lightness from 30% to 50%, the same as `.title`.

In mobile/topic-post.scss, `.topic-map h3` was converted to `dark-light-choose(50%, 50%)` instead of `(20%, 80%)`. This changes the light-theme lightness from 20% to 50% and diverges from desktop/topic-post.scss, which keeps 20/80.
In topic-post, a rule whose original light-theme value was `$lightness: 70%` now uses `$lightness: 30%` for the light theme, making the text darker.
The `.wmd-input` text color still uses `darken($primary, 40%)` and was not converted for themes.

Several converted one-line rules have a stray space before the closing brace (`)); }` instead of `));}`), for example in desktop/topic-list.scss, desktop/queued-posts.scss:14 and desktop/topic-post.scss.
The expression `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, X%), scale-color($secondary, 100-X%))` is hand-copied 115 times across 32 files instead of being encoded once in a one-argument helper.
`.topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification` still uses bare `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)` without dark-light-choose, so the conversion is incomplete.
The comment at common/base/discourse.scss:73 still describes the old default `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)`, which is stale after the conversion.
`#file-uploading` still uses `scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)`, while its sibling `#draft-status` was converted to dark-light-choose.
